column1: # The served Rust parity set (multi-user lane L3): every file here passes with GBRAIN_TEST_RUST_SERVED=1 (a served client of a
# brain server, multi_writer on) on both multi-user routes, env and config. scripts/run-rust-served-set.sh runs exactly
# the `served` rows; the trunk gates every merge on it. A file leaves the set only as an `excluded` row with a named reason.
